errata.notes:

errata.orig:
Note that when using either of these with a MUD file, because access
   is associated with a particular Thing, MUD files MUST NOT contain
   either a src-dnsname in an ACL associated with from-device-policy or
   a dst-dnsname associated with to-device-policy.
errata.correct:
Note that when using either of these with a MUD file, because access
   is associated with a particular Thing, MUD files MUST NOT contain
   either a src-dnsname in an ACL associated with from-device-policy or
   a dst-dnsname associated with to-device-policy.  If a MUD file
   violates this rule, the MUD manager MUST reject the file.
errata.notes:
This MUST NOT constrains MUD file contents only.  The document does
not specify what a MUD manager is to do when it receives a file that
violates it.  At least three behaviors are plausible: reject the whole
file, ignore the offending ACE, or drop only the dnsname match while
retaining the rest of the ACE.  These are not equivalent: the third
widens the ACE to match any host and turns a fail-closed rule into a
fail-open one.

Section 13.2 specifies handling for signature validation failure
("the MUD manager MUST cease processing the MUD file").  No
corresponding rule exists for violations of this MUST NOT.  The
correction adds explicit fail-closed handling consistent with Section
13.2.
